description: Retirement Lab runs hypothetical retirement projections from user-supplied financial, tax-residence, and market assumptions. It can save and compare scenarios, run parameter sweeps, inspect stored results, render projection summaries, preview selected taxes, and create unlisted public shares on explicit request.

defaultPrompt: How might my savings hold up in retirement? Help me set up a hypothetical simulation.
How would changing my annual spending affect my simulated retirement outcomes?
Compare retirement outcomes in the US, Portugal, and Spain, including modeled taxes. Ask me for the inputs you need.
